# Capy of Gods

> Capy of Gods is an action roguelike where a capybara climbs a colossal tower while its weapons fire on their own. Vertical platforming meets bullet-heaven combat. Out now in Early Access on Steam.

Capy of Gods is an action roguelike in which a capybara climbs a colossal tower while its weapons fire on their own. It mixes the wave combat of a bullet heaven with classic platforming and dodge-dashing, across procedurally generated floors, three climbs and more than 25 bosses. It is out now in Early Access on Steam, with a free demo.

- Developer: CapyEmber (one-person studio, Chile). Contact: capyember@gmail.com
- Platform: PC via Steam (Windows, Linux, macOS). Released in Early Access on November 9, 2026. USD 7.99. Free demo available.
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955600
- Trailer: https://youtu.be/9lMy9L7tKdw
- Discord: https://discord.gg/KsckWpZKXZ

## Characters

- Bob: starting weapon Toxic Drool; passive Detective's Nose (+1% crit chance per level; +10% luck every 10 levels)
- C-Rex: starting weapon Fiery Spit; passive Primal Fury (+1% damage per level; +1 Quantity on all weapons every 10 levels)
- Johnny: starting weapon Razor Fur; passive Hardened Shell (+1 armor per level; +3% weapon size every 10 levels)
- Capytain Gale: starting weapon Wild Gust; passive Tailwind (+2% dodge per level; +1 max jump every 10 levels)
- Deadeye: starting weapon Sniper Rifle; passive Lethal Aim (+1% crit chance per level; +25% crit damage every 10 levels)
- Dr. Plague: starting weapon Flamethrower; passive Burning Fever (+1% burn chance per level; +10% effect duration every 10 levels)
- Gary: starting weapon Octo Sentry; passive Assembly Line (+2% effect duration per level; +1 Quantity on all weapons every 10 levels)
- Lycap: starting weapon Claw Sweep; passive Bloodlust (+1% lifesteal per level; +20% movement speed every 10 levels)
- Sir Drake Jr.: starting weapon Valiant Slash; passive Hidalgo's Pride (+2% damage per level; +10 armor every 10 levels)
- Skelly-san: starting weapon Glow Stick; passive Idol Fever (+3% luck per level; +10% projectile speed every 10 levels)
- Sparky: starting weapon Thunder Coil; passive Overcharge (+1% attack speed per level; +10% projectile speed every 10 levels)
- Stinky: starting weapon Toxic Stench; passive Lingering Stink (+1% effect duration per level; +10% weapon size every 10 levels)

## Weapons

- Razor Fur: A bristling fur aura that damages anything nearby
- Claw Sweep: Rends enemies in a cone toward the nearest foe. On kill, 5% chance to heal 1 HP.
- Toxic Drool: Spits venomous projectiles that bounce between enemies
- Fiery Spit: Launches fireballs that burn monsters
- Flamethrower: Sprays a stream of flames that swivels toward the nearest enemy and may burn everything it sweeps across
- Glow Stick: Throws a stick that slows down, turns around and flies back. It hits on the way out and back.
- Thunder Coil: Summons electric shocks on nearby enemies
- Octo Sentry: Every 3 s deploys an octo sentry that lives 5 s and shoots nearby enemies using your stats.
- Sniper Rifle: Fires piercing shots that go through enemies in a line. Aim with the mouse or right stick
- Toxic Stench: Leaves stink clouds in your wake as you move. They hit whoever is inside and may poison them; the poison stacks without limit.
- Valiant Slash: Slashes an arc at the nearest foe. Every 3rd swing spins 360° with +100% crit chance.
- Wild Gust: Blows wind gusts that chase enemies. Gusts fired in midair deal double damage.

## Instincts

- Stone Skin: Your skin hardens like rock: gain armor that reduces damage taken
- Wild Reflexes: Increases attack speed
- Balanced Instinct: Each level raises damage, max health, movement speed and attack speed at once
- Chaotic Instinct: Each level boosts a random stat. Higher rarity hits harder: at legendary it's worth double its own instinct
- Keen Eye: Increases the chance to land critical hits
- Ferocious Bite: Increases critical hit damage
- Sharp Fangs: Increases damage of all attacks
- Dark Mark: More enemies with more health and a bit more damage, but they drop more gold
- Slippery Fur: Increases the chance to dodge enemy attacks
- Long Fuse: Extends the duration of the effects you cause
- Ancestral Instinct: Gain more experience per enemy
- Greedy Snout: Increases the gold dropped by enemies
- Young Blood: All healing you receive is more effective
- Bloodthirst: You steal life from your enemies: every direct hit heals you. Every 100% life steal = 1 health per hit.
- Fortune Whiskers: Increases the chance of higher rarity rewards
- Keen Nose: Attracts experience orbs from farther away
- Thick Hide: Increases maximum health
- Swift Paws: Increases movement speed
- Wild Momentum: Your projectiles fly faster and travel farther
- Extra Projectile: Your weapons fire more projectiles. Does not affect Razor Fur, Flamethrower or Toxic Stench.
- Steady Heartbeat: Recover a percentage of your max health every second
- Shell: Gain a blue shield that absorbs damage and regenerates when you avoid hits
- Coated Claws: Increases the chance to apply status effects; above 100% it applies extra stacks
- Scavenger's Instinct: Increases damage to enemies with an active status effect
- Spiked Fur: Your fur bristles with spikes: enemies that touch you lose part of their max health. Bosses, with tougher hides, only lose a tenth as much.
- Overgrowth: Makes your weapons and projectiles bigger

## Bosses

- Shoggoth: Flying horror that teleports around you and charges straight through. Read the tell before the dash.
- Voidborn Goddess: Predicts where you are going to dodge and drops her hand spell right there, followed by a spread of four projectiles.
- Voidcaller: Teleports around the arena and cycles dark flames, a laser and tentacles that rise from the ground.
- C-Rex: Appears if you accept the Ghost Capybara's request and destroy the obelisks. Defeating it starts the C-Rex unlock chain.
- Forest Whale: A flying whale that leaves a cloud of dust which makes nearby enemies stronger, fires a telegraphed dart and charges a slow energy ball.
- Mantis: A giant mantis that cycles three attacks: thrusts up close, a leaping slam marked on the ground and a cone of three blades.
- Fat Plant: A huge carnivorous plant that roots itself near you. Spore rings that poison, acid rain and a slow homing acid ball.
- Bringer of Death: Teleports to a platform in view every few seconds, slashes, fires a dark wave and drops portal hands right where you stand.
- Bone Wheel: A rolling wheel of bones. A burst of five ghost dashes, and a belly flop that falls from the sky on the mark under your feet.
- Death: Throws its scythe like a boomerang from above and below, dives at you and raises skeleton archers.
- Skelly-san: Comes through the pink door once you return the torn banners. Defeating it starts the Skelly-san unlock chain.
- Dino Rex: A giant dinosaur that freezes mid-air before a belly slam, crosses the room in a ghost dash and calls flags that rain balls from the sky.
- Pengu: A penguin in sunglasses: jumping pecks, ice blocks that fall in sequence and a sweeping beam.
- Lisa: A flying sorceress with five spells: rising bubbles, a water explosion, heads from the ground, ice walls that close in and falling spikes.
- Yeti: Arrives when you try to free the frozen climber in the snow. Snowballs in an arc and a jump that raises a wave of ice.
- Demon Samurai: A three-slash combo with a dash on each cut and a leaping strike. At half health it shouts, ignites its sword and gets faster and tougher.
- Puppet H: A floating stone puppet whose closed eyes reveal the next spell: closing rock walls, pillars where you stand or crystal fists from above.
- Bertha: A giant goblin with an axe: heavy combos, stomps that send earth eruptions forward, leaping slams and a five-second tornado.
- Morthag: Plants itself and breathes a huge frontal flame, raises fire tornadoes around you and charges an explosion overhead.
- Demon Slime: Starts as a bouncing slime with its own health bar. Then it transforms into a demon with a cleaver, triple jumps and black fire.
- Megumi: A salamander witch that sprints across the room casting black holes, fire tornadoes and fireballs. Every few spells her salamander becomes a dragon and fires a beam that crosses the whole level.
